Pecan Grove Catering

Full service event catering for weddings, corporate lunches and private parties.

We serve Austin, Round Rock, Cedar Park and the greater Travis County area.

Service styles

  • Buffet service with chafing dishes and staff
  • Plated dinners for seated events
  • Family style platters

Capacity

Our team can serve up to 200 guests at a single event.

Sample buffet menu

  • Smoked brisket with house barbecue sauce
  • Herb roasted chicken thighs
  • Grilled vegetable platter (vegan and gluten-free)
  • Three sisters salad: corn, beans and squash (vegan)
  • Jalapeno cornbread

Pricing

Buffet packages start at $22 per person and plated dinners at $38 per person. Staffing and rentals are quoted separately.

Dietary accommodations

Vegan and gluten-free options are available on every menu; tell us the count when you book.
